profile.selection: all crossing witnesses with abs(margin) <= measured technical repeat score range, all exact ties, plus first 8 crossing pairs by salted ID hash per dataset/intervention/K
profile.profile: rerun original batches containing selected queries, targets, and Kth competitors with all original batch companions; score the full catalog using the identical FP32 matrix shape and frozen profile; other vectors retain their compatible original profile
profile.label: numerical_ambiguity if any cutoff decision differs; no epsilon-based rank correction
